game.name: World Championship Poker featuring Howard Lederer (USA)
game.desc: World Championship Poker featuring Howard Lederer: All in lets you, as the name suggests, play poker on Xbox 360. There are twenty variations of the card game available, and the title also features a career world, special scenarios and the ability to create your own character from scratch, with some very crazy appearances.
